Standard: The laser fire control system requires two distinct and sequential actions to prevent inadvertent laser firing: an arming action, followed by a firing action, defined as a continuous crewmember input (e.g., pressing a dead-man switch) IAW MIL-STD-1425, Unintentional Output and Laser Fire Switch sections. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify laser system design (e.g., ICD, specifications, drawings, descriptions, flight manual) has two distinct and sequential actions required to fire the laser. Demonstration.
  (1) Verify that two distinct and sequential actions are required to fire the laser to prevent inadvertent firing of the laser in either ground or lab environments.
